lines: This episode presents evidentiary and testimonial material advancing three parallel lines of inquiry: (1) a reconciliation problem surrounding the timing of the "tarmac hug" between Erika Kirk and Andrew Kolvet, against Frank Turek's estimate of Erica's hospital arrival time; (2) a first-person timeline of September 10 drawn from Elizabeth Kravchuk McCoy, describing TPUSA Arizona office activity, the call chain, and the drive to Scottsdale airport; and (3) the publication of a 13-part Alexis Wilkins X thread alleging a coordinated foreign-influence network. The Frank Turek audio clip and Alexis Wilkins thread are read aloud on air and inscribed as artifacts. A separate phone call to a Hopkinson Aircraft employee who would "neither confirm nor deny" seeing Erica is also captured. The episode also presents a Daily Wire article and supporting news items on Catholic Church growth, with a prior Allie Stuckey tweet denial cited as a discourse artifact. Investigative questions introduced include the September 10 whereabouts of Stacy Sheridan, the precise call chain sequence, and verification of multiple Erika Kirk alibis.
